newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies seven municipal bond issues.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies seven municipal bond issues.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp. said on Thursday that it qualified for bond insurance the following seven municipal bond issues set for competitive sale.
--Warren County, Ky., $22.75 million first mortgage revs.
--Pillager ISD, Minn., $3.345 million school building GOs.
--Hillside Twp., N.J., $3.708 million general improvement bonds.
--West Deptford Township, N.J., school bonds, $8.880 million.
--Ossining UFSD, N.Y., $1.215 million school district GOs.
--Saranac Lake Central School District, N.Y., $4.320 million.
